topic: 近一年世界视频模型最可靠的应用任务

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): The review asks which application tasks are reliable, so discovery must separate training-time/offline assistance, policy evaluation, recovery, planning, and direct control, and must include counterevidence on action fidelity, physical adherence, long-horizon drift, and latency.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-policy-evaluation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND all:"policy evaluation" AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Test whether policy ranking and scalable evaluation have the strongest sim-real evidence.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-data-synthesis
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"data synthesis" OR all:"synthetic demonstrations") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover training-time generation and augmentation, where model errors are filtered before deployment.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-post-training-recovery
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"post-training" OR all:recovery OR all:"self-correction") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover failure-adjacent correction and policy post-training rather than unconstrained generation.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-planning-control
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"video world model" AND (all:planning OR all:control) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find direct planning/control evidence and its deployment constraints.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-admissibility
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"action fidelity" OR all:"physics adherence" OR all:"failure optimism") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Test whether visual realism is insufficient for decision use.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-long-horizon-efficiency
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND all:robot AND (all:"long-horizon" OR all:latency OR all:efficiency)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover compounding rollout error and online inference cost.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-geometry-distillation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:4D OR all:geometry OR all:"point track") AND all:"robot manipulation"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover training-time geometry supervision and distillation that may improve policies without online rollout cost.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-action-model-contact
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"world action model" OR all:"video world model") AND (all:contact OR all:tactile OR all:force) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Check reliability boundaries for contact-rich manipulation and partially observed physics.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-reliable-world-model-tasks-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs 2026 robot video world model policy evaluation data synthesis recovery planning
dynamic_suggestions.why: Discover newly submitted task-oriented papers if the API under-recovers.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-neural-simulator-web
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs 2026 robot neural simulator world model policy evaluation
dynamic_suggestions.why: Calibrate current naming around video-world-model evaluators.

calibration_notes: arxiv calibration (high): RoboWorld uses neural simulator, policy evaluation, Step Forcing, task-progress-aware scoring, and sim-real rank alignment.
arxiv calibration (high): Qwen-RobotWorld groups current applications into synthetic data generation, virtual policy evaluation, and language-guided planning signals.
arxiv calibration (high): MotuBrain uses the current term world action model for joint video-action prediction and real-time control.
arxiv calibration (high): Persistent Robot World Models foregrounds autoregressive rollout drift and rollout-stabilizing post-training.
